prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV01 floor layer, independently painted gouache game scenery. Full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 canvas, true transparent alpha in the upper area.
Primary request: A sunlit broad warm limestone harbor plaza viewed at a gentle elevated three-quarter angle. This is ONLY the ground plane for a mobile puzzle game's playable stage, on transparent background. Large soft cream and pale apricot irregular paving slabs, subtle hand-painted joints, lightly worn edges, tiny moss in rare seams near the outer edges. Low contrast at center so small colorful props remain readable. Pretty rich gouache brushwork on paper, chunky storybook simplification, lavender contact shadows, warm afternoon cream light.
Composition: Upper 35 percent of canvas is completely transparent. From a roughly horizontal high boundary at 35 percent, the ground extends continuously across the entire canvas width down to the bottom edge. Large calm uncluttered open paving surface, no raised step across the center, no obstacle. Keep full canvas and transparent upper margin.
Constraints: Do not draw water or pools; actual gameplay water will be composited on top of this floor using exact geometry. No cliff, no dock edge, no walls, no buildings, no sky, no horizon landscape, no grass lawn, no reeds, no plants, no boxes, no boats, no bollards, no ropes, no characters. No text, no UI, no watermark. Genuine alpha above the ground, not an opaque cream rectangle. This is one independent floor asset, not a complete postcard.
